scope: New blank/input options and strict fixed-detector complementarity; independent RGB-only dataset and one gated scratch training run

tests.initial_failures: Missing tools; then demonstrated silent truncation, absent image acceptance and invalid empty-denominator results
tests.regressions: Full candidate and top-box prefix matches original A1 exactly on five real frames
real_gpu_options: RGB input using old A0 weights for plumbing only

data_audit.initial_audit_failure: np.round versus Python six-decimal formatting at halfway values; failed evidence retained; only audit fixed

review.correctness: Strict exact prediction/annotation lengths; missing predictions raise; modality-coordinate metadata checked; null empty ratios
review.readability: Input construction and coordinate conversion have small tested helpers
review.architecture: Independent study and dataset; existing scorer unchanged
review.security: No new dependencies, caches or raw dataset publication; portable aliases for execution metadata
review.performance: Hard links avoid image duplication; full video decoding remains necessary

evidence_limits: Blank inputs are OOD interventions, not strict causal bounds
Fixed-output oracle is not an upper bound on learned fusion
Each modality uses its own coordinates; cross-modality success is not IR-coordinate improvement
Single seed, validation only, IR-based frame sampling and stretched RGB resolution
